# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** 6 or 7 years old  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Dora is a fair child with long, sleek hazel curls that never get out of order. She has gentle, mild hazel eyes and a straight nose. She possesses a neat, 'prunes and prisms' mouth.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025)_

## Personality

Dora is timid, quiet, and exceptionally well-behaved, behaving like a little lady at all times. She is prim, proper, and agreeable, contrastingly opposite to her mischievous twin brother. She tends to take things seriously and easily gets frightened by ghost stories or the dark.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c10 P14](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0014), [v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002), [v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007)_

## Traits

- Quiet and prim  <sub>[v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002)</sub>
- Well-behaved and ladylike  <sub>[v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012)</sub>
- Timid and easily frightened  <sub>[v2 c10 P14](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0014), [v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007)</sub>
- Fear of the dark  <sub>[v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003)</sub>

## Goals

- To marry Paul Irving in the future

## History

Dora and her twin brother Davy are taken in by Marilla Cuthbert after their mother, Mary Keith, passes away. Upon moving to Green Gables, Dora behaves politely and ladylike, making a stark contrast to her unruly brother. She sleeps in Marilla's room and adjusts calmly to her new surroundings. In the autumn, Dora enters Avonlea School alongside Davy, where she is temporarily placed with older student Mirabel Cotton. After Mirabel tells her stories about deceased relatives and family ghosts, Dora becomes deeply frightened of the dark until Anne Shirley comforts her and settles her to sleep.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c8 P13](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0013), [v2 c8 P26](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0026), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002), [v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 c21 P8](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0008)_
